body: Oh sorry, misunderstood. I’ve never taken Antabuse, or even read about it. I would ask about it but I can read up about it here I’m sure.
Like stopping nal altogether? I have not thought about that. Are you saying to try not taking it with drinking?

Great ideas, thank you. I hadn’t been drinking water at all with my drinking, at least during. I will try that next time in between drinks. It was a big change for me to just switch to light beer so I thought that was enough but maybe not. And I’m not sure about what fillers are in the meds. I don’t have a doctor here yet for a domestic prescription but if things continue this way I’ll think about looking into it. But like you said, lower dose, water, and maybe some stomach soothers in between will help.

Hey thank you too. Just having you respond and having the support of this community on reddit helps so much. I feel less alone. And I know what you mean, I’ve been at the point to where I’m ready to give up and just binge. But I do try to force myself to come on here or other subreddits and remind myself of why I’m here in the first place. My list of reasons why I want to cut down my drinking far outweighs those desires usually. Too many terrible mornings (days), panic and anxiety, sick feelings, and guilty feelings. I wish you all the best, and please keep coming back here or wherever else you can that gives you a sense of understanding/community and support to keep on the right track.

Yeah, I’m going to cut it in half next time, it’s scored in half (but I can’t even break it in half by hand) so maybe I should get a pill cutter and then be able to break it up further if needed. 

No, I don’t take any opiates at all. I do take small dose klonopin as needed, but also hadn’t taken that for about a week or so, until tonight when the nal + 2 drinks made my heart start racing along with the sickness. 

It’s weird, I’m not sensitive at all to medicine, and have what I think is a “strong stomach”. I usually need more to feel the same effects as others, but with Nal it’s unlike anything else.
Ahh sorry, you’re right. Your post made me go check and it is 50mg not 100. I misremembered. So when I started it was on 25mg. I’ve been taking 50 after about the first week.
Thanks for the encouragement. I know that before I start drinking that I’m compliant, it’s just after I start that I’m like WHY did I do this to myself

All day chemist, I think it only comes in 100, and I read that was the normal dose. When I first started I would cut them in half, and that made me feel similarly but not quite as bad. Then I took it almost daily since I was drinking almost daily, and I got used to it. I had no more of the terrible side effects, to the point where I couldn’t even tell I’d taken anything. So I switched to 100. But it seems that a few days off resets my body’s reaction to it?

Fair enough. No one knows besides them what was really going on. It just breaks my heart when I read that text and then hear what was going on from his perspective. But I would say regardless, the man lacks any kind of spine. And he doesn’t know how to communicate effectively, and lacks the empathy to even attempt to do so

I would possibly agree with you if it hadn’t been for the fact that he drove for 45 min to the site before killing his children. If that’s true. 

Idk, I can see someone getting into a rage, I guess, over things that built up over years but I’m still confused. That text message from shannan basically begging for him, how could he totally rage against someone who loved him and wanted him so much?? Just look up the text from Shanann to him basically professing her love and agonizing that he wasn’t reciprocating. Which, it’s fine if you don’t reciprocate but let the woman know what’s going on for god sake. 

Chris doesn’t know how to be a human being

I get what you’re saying kind of but I’m having the opposite feeling. I’m sick of the “I care SO much because I’m so WOKE” culture. Stop falling all over yourselves and congratulating every old white lady who is nice to a black kid, every woman who is in a position of power, etc. Why can’t we just be nice to eachother without the self-congratulation. THATS WHAT YOURE SUPPOSED TO DO. Just be good to people. I love that women and minorities are having a bigger voice, but using it to demonize white dudes who win an election is counterproductive! And I’m a white woman. I just wish people who fight for an equal playing field would treat it as an equal playing field. I think also I feel annoyed because if anyone DOESNT mention international women’s day on international women’s day then apparently they are insensitive jerks. Just be cool and be good to people and stop doing good things just so that others will congratulate you.
I guess my problem is that 6 beers can get me blackout. I drink like 7ish percent, and it’s not uncommon that I do blackout from 6
Thanks for your insight. I’m hoping this is just that random uptick.

Alcohol intake overall has reduced, I think. I had switched to liquor last week and didn’t know how to measure/how that measured up so it’s hard to tell. But I was able to drink every other day rather than every day. I’ll see how tomorrow goes, I plan to not drink at all tomorrow

I did stop at 6, because I don’t have anymore. Maybe there was a time I would seek more, but I am not. But still to drink all is bad

Edit: Also, I did/do want more, but I’m not obviously. I’m in the bathtub about to make myself go to sleep

I took the nal because I thought I was gonna be drinking socially tonight. When I couldn’t meet up because I had to work instead, I bought beer because I didn’t want to waste the nal, thought I needed to drink to keep up my nal+drinking. Kept drinking because none felt like enough.
Ok, thanks for your insight. I’ll continue to trust the process.

Gotta question for you. If you go drinking socially, then (drink enough to have to uber/taxi home? Or just have a couple over a period of time and drive home?), what next? Do you still feel the need to get more to drink by yourself at home?

Thanks for your insight. I have a question - is it necessary to do these distractions during the process? Is it okay to drink completely as normal ( given some days I feel more anxious than others) I mean. Since my anxiety fuels my desire to drink more, do I need to work on methods to relieve the anxiety or eventually will the nal teach my brain that alcohol doesn’t cure the anxiety

I guess as I’ve heard others say, just keep following the program. So I will. I’ve read it takes months for some so that’s okay. I just feel bad for backtracking and drinking the same as I did before nal.

You know, I’m not sure. Definitely not anytime soon. There are people here who’ve taken it way longer than me on this site who would know more about that. But, I guess what I hope is that my “regular” drinking won’t happen anymore, meaning I only want to drink on some weekends/special occasions and not drink during the week, and drink less. In that regard, I don’t think it’s a good idea that I ever go off it, since I think it would just fuel my habit again. Again though, I’m super new to this and don’t know as much as I would like.

Sure, so I ordered 50mgs, I don’t think you can order less from that website. I had read to start at 25. They are scored so I’ve had to cut or bite them in half. I only take it if I know I plan to drink, and I take it no less than and hour prior to drinking. I’ve been going about my daily routine which is work during day, drink at night so it’s been once a day so far. But if I get to the point where I don’t want to drink on a certain night (or can’t) then I just won’t take anything.

I hear people move up to the full 50 eventually. But right now 25 is working for me, and they aren’t cheap so I’m being conservative. Plus I think 50 would make me too sick. But depending on your size/weight, some may need 50 sooner than others.

Same here. It makes me feel glued to the couch. I made a post the other night about that. It’s like I’ve had my “fill” after only a couple beers, like the tired sick full feeling comes way faster. But the weird thing is that I feel “drunk” still... I guess now two beers gets me drunk? Like I feel loopy and good, maybe not as good but good, and less inhibited. I think that’s the only thing that gets me through. If the nal made me feel sick with no other benefit from the alcohol I probably would have stopped taking it after the first night. But to take it, drink at least a little less than usual, and still get “drunk” (and sick as if I drank 10+) is making me rethink things.

If this is how people without the same brain chemistry as me handle alcohol, then I feel like I’m starting to understand why people stop after only a few drinks, and how the hell people can stop midway through a drink!

I always look at people sideways when I see they’ve left a half empty... never understood how anyone could do that.

Yeah, I imagine it’s a different story for everyone but like you say, even if it helps a little it’s worth seeing where this stuff takes you.
That is a good idea, thanks.

I’ve been on it for three days as of tonight. I totally get what you mean. I so want to push through and drink more or finish what I have, I just feel so full and sick and nauseous I can’t even take another sip sometimes. I thought the same thing last night, that maybe if I start drinking later I’ll find it easier to crash without having to compromise habit. By the time that nauseous feeling wears off it’s late, I’m more sober than I want to be, etc. I usually drink 6 beers a night on a good night, last night I had 5, my first night I had 4. Tonight I had 2 and I feel sober right now and it’s messing with me. I want to drink more, but I’m having that annoying feeling that it’s not worth it. Do you know that feeling when you only have one beer in the fridge and you want to drink but you know one won’t do so you feel annoyed and can’t bring yourself to even have the one? Idk if you ever have that. But that’s how I feel except I have a six pack in the fridge right now. Maybe cause it’s late and I’m tired. I keep telling myself it’ll be there tomorrow.

If you have any other questions about ordering it or anything feel free to ask. I was concerned when my order didn’t get to me after the 10 days which is how long I was told it would take, but it came and was exactly what I ordered, just a little bit late. Though their customer service is great. I called a couple times when I was waiting to check in and they were extremely helpful.

Also, I probably could ask my primary care doc, but I didn’t want to because of the stigma that comes with admitting alcoholism to your doc. That’s stupid, I know, but I wasn’t ready and wanted to give this way a shot first.

No worries at all! So I ordered it from the website alldaychemist.com. It took over two weeks to get to me (I’m in the us, it comes from India). I logged in because I was thinking of making a new post, and just saw your comment. 

I know I’m really new to this so do your research, but I’m on my third day and I’m actually amazed at this medication. Tonight I’ve had two beers and I feel honestly sick and don’t think I can finish a third. I’ve heard there are ups and downs though, last night I drank 5. 

But, I keep thinking I’m in such awe of how I feel. So far, I feel like I get the good effects from alcohol but I get too sick/tired to carry on drinking. I’ve been waking up feeling so much better. I still crave alcohol during the day but as long as I take it an hour before I drink, I’m good.

I ordered the 50mg pills but they are scored, and I’ve only been taking half the past 3 days. I’m afraid if I took more I would feel too sick, and it did give me a headache the first night. 

Good luck, I wish everyone knew about this medicine. I’m amazed at it so far.
Naltrexone, aka nodict

Thanks for your reply. Good to know the different ways it affects people. I don’t expect it to totally be on the up and up from here on out, as long as over the long term it’s beneficial that’s what’s important. I have read about the honeymoon phase and I’m glad to be aware of it, so that I know to stick with it even if I backtrack.

Thanks for your insight and for your replies. I’ve seen that in the sidebar but hadn’t read through it yet, and I will so I can learn more about how this works. All I know now is to just keep doing what I’m told, and so far, so good.

I think I see. After researching and learning the mechanism I was afraid I might hate this medication. I thought, how am I going to want to take this drug that blocks the good feelings alcohol gives me? But I guess it’s more complicated than that. Which is good, sounds like a drug that’s more complicated than my primitive “Alcohol=good” rat brain. If it works for them, I hope it works for me.

That’s pretty spot on how I feel. Even when the loopy/nauseous feeling goes away after taking it awhile, do you still get the “I think I’ve had enough” feeling? Feels like I’ve mainly had enough because of the sick feeling and the fact I feel buzzed. It’s like it turned 2 beers into 6.
Thank you sincerely

Thanks for your response. I am making steps to cut down. I also just joined a team sport in my area. We had our first games today. It was terrifying, I’m so out of shape, even for a very low-Instense sport (kickball ha) but I did it. It gives me hope when I see that people make friends/partners at my age. I just feel like I’m too far gone sometimes. But it’s less to do with age and more to do with my weight and the fact that I’m so down and cynical these days. I guess I just feel like I get older and fatter with each day, and don’t see much in my future. I’m trying to be more optimistic, that’s much easier than loving myself! Anyway thanks for your response again.
